# System font selection fixtures

These are original diagnostic outlines generated by `generate.py` with
fonttools 4.59.2. They contain space, A and B, and are dedicated under CC0-1.0
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). They are not copies of
an installed typeface. Fonttools is needed only to regenerate these committed
assets; it is not a runtime or CI dependency.

The family is `Omoikane Fixture`. The fonts all have 1000 units/em, ascent 800,
descent -200, and distinct outlines and advances so the tests can verify the
loaded face through metadata, shaping, measurement and rasterized pixels.

| Face | Weight | Style | Width class | A/B advance |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Regular | 400 | normal | 5 | 500 |
| Bold | 700 | normal | 5 | 700 |
| Italic | 400 | italic | 5 | 600 |
| BoldItalic | 700 | italic | 5 | 800 |
| Condensed | 400 | normal | 3 | 350 |

`OmoikaneFixture.ttc` contains Bold at index 0, Regular at index 1 and Italic
at index 2. A normal request must select index 1, and both shaping and painting
must use that index. Tests also copy the fonts under misleading file names and
in different directory orders; names and styles come from OpenType tables.

`OmoikaneFallback-Regular.ttf` is the separate family `Omoikane Fallback`.
It adds U+0301 and U+4E2D (`中`), with a zero-width combining mark and 900-unit
base advances. It verifies CJK coverage and that `A` plus U+0301 stays in one
fallback font run without depending on the host's installed fonts.

`OmoikaneMacRoman.ttc` contains Regular, Bold and Italic faces of `Omoikane Café`
at indices 0, 1 and 2. Its name table contains only Macintosh Roman records,
including the non-ASCII `é`, to verify discovery without Unicode name records.
The [Apple name-table specification](https://developer.apple.com/fonts/TrueType-Reference-Manual/RM06/Chap6name.html)
defines the platform and encoding IDs; all outlines remain original CC0 fixtures.

Regenerate with Python 3 and `fonttools==4.59.2` installed:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/anonymized-font-selection/generate.py
```
